validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done" event:schema="event-schemas/order.json#/$defs/Ordr"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the fragment of `event:schema` does not select a schema in schema file `event-schemas/order.json`: the JSON Pointer `/$defs/Ordr` names no value
notes: the fragment of a schema reference is a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901), percent-encoded as a URI fragment: `#/$defs/Order` selects member `Order` of member `$defs`; `~1` stands for `/` and `~0` for `~` in a member name
